limitations: Only regular odd Reuleaux polygons; no irregular classification, no uniqueness of optimizing centers. The n=3 reference is known. The 1951 Besicovitch article remains inaccessible in full, and direct full comparison with Jin (2016) was unavailable though Guo–Jin (2017) identifies its invariant as Lu–Pan perimeter asymmetry.
scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic analytic theorem; finite ray-integral checks are supplementary and independent audit has not been conducted.
title: Exact Kovner–Besicovitch area ratio of regular Reuleaux odd-gons
